export_policy: LF-normalized UTF-8 text under root .gitattributes. No whitespace trimming or error removal. Credentials/private snapshots excluded. Historical checked-in logs otherwise preserved.

artifacts.transformation: Three CRLF sequences become LF; pre-staging manifest hashed 1262-byte working copy, Git clean filter published 1259 bytes. Confirmed against original artifact and original Git blob.

Remove catch-block console.log of fixture_error:e.message (55 bytes) to avoid accidental private error detail. Original and export compared during remediation; environment-safety.json retains original digest, not shipped digest.
